features.hypothesis: For every binary input pair i_a, i_b in {0,1}, after applying the pair and allowing 1 ns for settling, o_sum equals i_a XOR i_b and o_carry equals i_a AND i_b.
features.scope: The half_adder top-level outputs for the four two-state input combinations only; outputs are sampled 1 ns after each input pair is applied.

discovery_basis.rationale: The interface declares scalar inputs i_a and i_b and scalar outputs o_sum and o_carry.
The description identifies the module as a combinational half-adder without clock or stored state.
The SystemC evaluate method writes XOR of the two inputs to o_sum.
The SystemC evaluate method writes AND of the two inputs to o_carry.

unknowns: The exact delta-cycle update count and latency were not measured; this campaign samples outputs 1 ns after applying each binary input pair.
